description: Read or set the document's text defaults (Textvorgaben) – the font, style, size and paragraph style every new text frame inherits and that set_text writes as local formatting. Without parameters it is read-only. Each setter works on its own; a failing one lands in problems[] without aborting the others. font takes a family name as InDesign shows it or "Family\tStyle" with a tab; font_style the style name ("Bold"); point_size 0–1296; paragraph_style the style name (not style_name). Returns the values after the change: font, font_style, point_size, paragraph_style, character_style, changed_fields[] and problems[].

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

font.description: Font family, or "Family\tStyle" with a tab character.

paragraph_style.description: Paragraph style name to use as default.

name: document_text_defaults
title: Document text defaults
